scripts.build: npm run build -w @dialed/shared && npm run build -w dialed-api && npm run build -w dialed-ui
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @dialed/shared && npm run dev -w dialed-api
scripts.dev:ui: npm run build -w @dialed/shared && npm run dev -w dialed-ui
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w dialed-api && npm run lint -w dialed-ui
scripts.test: npm run build -w @dialed/shared && npm run test -w @dialed/shared && npm run test -w dialed-api && npm run test -w dialed-ui
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test
